The test image shows a soybean leaf with:
- Dark reddish-brown to black irregular lesions
- Yellowish-green halos around several lesions
- Angular spot shapes
- Some tissue dropout/holes in leaf
- Scattered small spots with yellow borders

Top candidates: **Bacterial_Blight** (angular lesions, yellow-green halos), **Frogeye_leaf_spot** (circular spots, reddish borders), **Septoria_brown_spot** (angular red-brown spots).

Let me view reference images for these candidates and a few others in parallel.

The test image shows dark reddish-brown irregular spots with prominent yellow-green halos. Bacterial Blight looks promising — small spots with yellowish halos. Frogeye has more circular/uniform spots. Let me check more references.

Key observations from references:
- **Bacterial_Pustule**: Dense tiny brown spots, no yellow halos matching test image
- **Downy_mildew**: Pale/yellowing areas, very different
- **Soybean_rust**: Microscopic pustules on underside
- **Phyllosticta**: Gray-tan lesions with dark margins, some shot-hole dropout - partially similar

The test image closely matches **Bacterial_Blight** with dark reddish-brown centers and distinct yellowish-green halos. Let me check a few more to confirm.

I've now viewed 12 reference images. None of the other candidates match:
- **Cercospora**: Purple/bronze discoloration, leathery texture
- **Sudden_death_syndrome**: Interveinal chlorosis, white pith
- **Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus**: Mottling/mosaic pattern
- **Tobacco_Streak_Virus**: Pod symptoms, tissue proliferation

**Final analysis of the test image:**
- Dark reddish-brown centers with distinct **yellowish-green halos** — the hallmark of Bacterial_Blight
- Angular, irregular lesions that have coalesced in some areas
- Tissue dropout visible where dead tissue falls out
- Young-to-mid canopy green leaf affected
- No fungal structures, no purple/bronze coloration, not circular/uniform enough for Frogeye

This matches the Bacterial_Blight description precisely: *"Lesions have dark reddish-brown centers surrounded by yellowish-green halos around water-soaked tissue; lesions may coalesce to form large, irregularly shaped lesions."*

{"prediction": "Bacterial_Blight", "confidence": 0.82, "reasoning": "The test image shows a green soybean leaf with angular, dark reddish-brown lesions surrounded by prominent yellowish-green halos — the classic diagnostic signature of Bacterial_Blight. Several lesions have coalesced into larger irregular areas and tissue dropout (shot-holes) is visible where dead tissue fell out. No fungal structures, no purple/bronze tint (Cercospora), no uniform circular spots with reddish rings (Frogeye), and no dense tiny pustules (Bacterial_Pustule). The yellowish-green halo around dark centers on an otherwise green leaf is the key distinguishing feature."}
